CustomField.description: Stores the relative path to this page's banner/header image, set on the Form Template record page through the formImageSelector component (selectorLabel 'Banner/Header Image'). The companion Form Banner Image URL formula turns this stored path into an absolute, renderable URL. Text(255). Configured per page in the builder UI; the form runtime does not currently render this directly, so its primary role is to feed the URL formula and the record-page preview.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Use the Banner/Header Image selector on the page record to set this — it stores the chosen image path for the page. The Form Banner Image URL field automatically turns this path into a full, displayable image URL; you normally set this through the selector rather than typing a path.
CustomField.label: Form Banner Image
